name: montana_cadastral
summary: Montana Statewide Cadastral Parcel Registry (ArcGIS MSDI Parcels)
corpus: Montana State Library MSDI Framework Cadastral Parcels layer (taxpayer owner name, geocode, assessment value, county).
not_searched: Unrecorded deeds or recent property transfers not yet synced from county assessors to MSDI
Parcels held in states outside Montana or beneficial owners behind Montana/Delaware/Wyoming LLCs
caveats: Owner names match assessor tax-roll strings (often LAST FIRST or LLC name); pass `--where "UPPER(OwnerName) LIKE '%...%'"` for custom SQL queries.
